source_issues.source_claim: Tune on held-out validation set using X_val/y_val.
source_issues.concern: Documentation defines train/test only, so X_val/y_val are undefined when concatenating its displayed snippets.
source_issues.translation_treatment: Source faithfully retained; no translation correction requested. Keep the source issue separate from translation approval.

source_issues.source_claim: Apply the validation-best threshold to the test probabilities.
source_issues.concern: Threshold selected for w_val/b_val fitted on a train subset is then used with probs_cw from w_cw/b_cw fitted on all training data. Refitting can change calibration; this requires validation rather than assumed exact transfer.
source_issues.translation_treatment: Source faithfully retained; no translation correction requested. Keep the source issue separate from translation approval.

source_issues.concern: n_synthetic=0 returns shape(0,), not(0,n_features), so the usual vstack fails; negative counts likewise produce empty1-D output.
source_issues.translation_treatment: Source faithfully retained; no translation correction requested. Keep the source issue separate from translation approval.

source_issues.concern: Documentation lacks k<1/singleton guard present in the code file. One minority point yields no neighbor; empty/invalid inputs are not uniformly supported.
source_issues.translation_treatment: Source faithfully retained; no translation correction requested. Keep the source issue separate from translation approval.

source_issues.source_claim: Sweep thresholds0.0 to1.0 and choose optimum.
source_issues.concern: Implementation scans only.05 through.95 at.01 spacing, so optima outside range or between grid points are missed; strict > picks the first tied threshold.
source_issues.translation_treatment: Source faithfully retained; no translation correction requested. Keep the source issue separate from translation approval.

source_issues.concern: Empty arrays have zero accuracy denominator. MCC zero for a constant classifier is a convention for its undefined raw ratio. Documentation count products use NumPy integers and can overflow at very large counts before float conversion, unlike code int conversion.
source_issues.translation_treatment: Source faithfully retained; no translation correction requested. Keep the source issue separate from translation approval.

source_issues.source_claim: Evaluate with F1,AUPRC,MCC and build a complete combined pipeline.
source_issues.concern: No AUPRC function/report is implemented; scratch demo compares treatments rather than a single SMOTE+weights+optimized-threshold model.
source_issues.translation_treatment: Source faithfully retained; no translation correction requested. Keep the source issue separate from translation approval.

source_issues.source_claim: Class weighting equivalent to oversampling in expectation and avoids duplicate overfit.
source_issues.concern: Expected empirical-loss weighting equivalence does not imply elimination of overfitting; optimizer/normalization/regularization settings matter.
source_issues.translation_treatment: Source faithfully retained; no translation correction requested. Keep the source issue separate from translation approval.

source_issues.concern: Useful no-skill reference, but finite-sample empirical PR area depends on ranking draws and interpolation/integration convention; not a guaranteed equality per sample.
source_issues.translation_treatment: Source faithfully retained; no translation correction requested. Keep the source issue separate from translation approval.

source_issues.source_claim: 0.5 arbitrary, optimum usually lower; ranking allows separating fraud; calibration does not change AUC.
source_issues.concern: Optimum depends on cost/objective and calibration; perfect separation needs all positive scores above all negatives. Platt scaling preserves rank for a positive slope, may reverse or collapse with other fitted slopes.
source_issues.translation_treatment: Source faithfully retained; no translation correction requested. Keep the source issue separate from translation approval.

source_issues.source_claim: Lower threshold means lower precision and higher recall, and vice versa.
source_issues.concern: Recall is nondecreasing under a lowered threshold, but precision need not decrease monotonically.
source_issues.translation_treatment: Source faithfully retained; no translation correction requested. Keep the source issue separate from translation approval.

source_issues.concern: First calls80/20 mild; second labels70/30–95/5 moderate. Ratio/data-size cutoffs are illustrative heuristics, not universal guarantees.
source_issues.translation_treatment: Source faithfully retained; no translation correction requested. Keep the source issue separate from translation approval.

source_issues.source_claim: Balanced bootstrap = all minority plus random majority subset; SMOTE+balanced weights.
source_issues.concern: Bootstrap normally entails replacement, which the exercise simplification does not specify. Balanced weights computed after full balancing are equal, so the pipeline may not add extra minority penalty.
source_issues.translation_treatment: Source faithfully retained; no translation correction requested. Keep the source issue separate from translation approval.

author_source_issues.source_claim: Always-majority prediction minimizes error; application rates and rarer consequential cases are generalized.
author_source_issues.concern: Class frequency alone does not establish optimal predictions when discriminative features exist; application rates are illustrative, not universal.
author_source_issues.translation_treatment: Preserved original claim/code/math without silent correction; caveat isolated in author evidence.

author_source_issues.source_claim: A random classifier has AUPRC equal to class prevalence.
author_source_issues.concern: Population/no-skill baseline interpretation is standard, but a finite randomly ranked empirical PR area depends on interpolation and estimator conventions.
author_source_issues.translation_treatment: Preserved original claim/code/math without silent correction; caveat isolated in author evidence.

author_source_issues.source_claim: MCC=0 for always-negative predictions.
author_source_issues.concern: The displayed denominator is zero here; zero is an implementation convention, not the literal formula result.
author_source_issues.translation_treatment: Preserved original claim/code/math without silent correction; caveat isolated in author evidence.

author_source_issues.source_claim: Ratios and sample-count bands determine preferred strategies; optimal threshold usually much lower.
author_source_issues.concern: These are heuristics; calibration, costs, overlap and model family matter. Weighted scores may require a higher cutoff.
author_source_issues.translation_treatment: Preserved original claim/code/math without silent correction; caveat isolated in author evidence.

author_source_issues.source_claim: Duplication causes overfitting; SMOTE reduces it; weighting avoids duplicated-sample risk.
author_source_issues.concern: Duplication reweights the empirical objective and does not necessarily overfit; SMOTE can introduce invalid or noisy points. Weighting has related statistical effects.
author_source_issues.translation_treatment: Preserved original claim/code/math without silent correction; caveat isolated in author evidence.

author_source_issues.source_claim: Weights mathematically equivalent to oversampling in expectation.
author_source_issues.concern: Equivalence requires matching class sampling probabilities and objective normalization; optimization noise, regularization and training schedules can differ. Formula shows sum but implementation averages.
author_source_issues.translation_treatment: Preserved original claim/code/math without silent correction; caveat isolated in author evidence.

author_source_issues.source_claim: Sweep thresholds 0.0 to1.0.
author_source_issues.concern: Code only samples np.arange(.05,.96,.01), roughly .05–.95; may miss outside-grid optimum and uses first maximum on ties.
author_source_issues.translation_treatment: Preserved original claim/code/math without silent correction; caveat isolated in author evidence.

author_source_issues.source_claim: Ranking matters less than calibration; higher fraud probabilities admit a separating threshold.
author_source_issues.concern: A perfect separator requires every fraud score above every non-fraud score; merely generally higher/ranking well is insufficient. Calibration matters for cost-based decisions.
author_source_issues.translation_treatment: Preserved original claim/code/math without silent correction; caveat isolated in author evidence.

author_source_issues.source_claim: SMOTE creates n_synthetic rows and caps k at n_samples-1.
author_source_issues.concern: Zero requested rows yields shape(0,), not (0,n_features), so vstack can fail. Negative requested rows also silently produce empty output. Prose lacks file guard for fewer than2 minority samples.
author_source_issues.translation_treatment: Preserved original claim/code/math without silent correction; caveat isolated in author evidence.

author_source_issues.source_claim: Metric argument supports f1/recall/precision.
author_source_issues.concern: Unknown metric leaves score unbound in prose; file instead assigns0 and returns an arbitrary first cutoff.
author_source_issues.translation_treatment: Preserved original claim/code/math without silent correction; caveat isolated in author evidence.

author_source_issues.source_claim: Evaluation functions calculate accuracy and MCC.
author_source_issues.concern: Empty input has unguarded accuracy denominator. Prose uses NumPy integer products before float conversion, risking overflow on sufficiently large data; file converts counts to Python int.
author_source_issues.translation_treatment: Preserved original claim/code/math without silent correction; caveat isolated in author evidence.

author_source_issues.source_claim: Step7 uses held-out validation then says the script runs all of this.
author_source_issues.concern: X_val and y_val are undefined in prose. File creates a validation subset and separately trains w_val but transfers its cutoff to w_cw trained on all training data.
author_source_issues.translation_treatment: Preserved original claim/code/math without silent correction; caveat isolated in author evidence.

author_source_issues.source_claim: Evaluate with AUPRC and build a combined SMOTE+weights+threshold pipeline.
author_source_issues.concern: No AUPRC computation is supplied. Scratch examples compare separate strategies; production pipeline combines SMOTE and balanced weights but not threshold optimization. With equal post-SMOTE counts balanced weights become uniform.
author_source_issues.translation_treatment: Preserved original claim/code/math without silent correction; caveat isolated in author evidence.

author_source_issues.source_claim: Use It demonstrates production techniques.

author_source_issues.source_claim: Borderline-SMOTE means minority points whose neighbors include majority samples.
author_source_issues.concern: This broad condition omits standard danger/noise distinctions and can include isolated noisy minority points.
author_source_issues.translation_treatment: Preserved original claim/code/math without silent correction; caveat isolated in author evidence.

author_source_issues.source_claim: Platt calibration never changes ranking/AUC.

author_source_issues.translation_treatment: Preserved original claim/code/math without silent correction; caveat isolated in author evidence.

author_source_issues.concern: Bootstrap normally specifies sampling with replacement; source does not specify replacement and describes a subset, leaving bagging construction ambiguous.
author_source_issues.translation_treatment: Preserved original claim/code/math without silent correction; caveat isolated in author evidence.

author_source_issues.source_claim: Lowering threshold lowers precision and raising it raises precision.
